There exists a bounded self-adjoint tuple X in a faithful normal tracial von Neumann algebra with -infinity < chi(X) <= chi*(X)-1/2 < infinity for the original cutoff-limsup microstates entropy.

For every centered bounded self-adjoint signal tuple, every u>0, every multi-index j and every polynomial P, D_j(P)=u^(-|j|/2) tau(U_j(S)^* P(C+sqrt(u)S)); the original-adjacent-deletion Wick words are orthonormal. No freeness among signal coordinates is required.

For a centered bounded self-adjoint tuple with diagonal covariance, the L2-summable adjoint-Wick residual gives 0 <= Phi*(V_u)-sum_i 1/(u+c_i) <= u^(-2) sum_(r>=2) u^(-r) ||kappa_(r+1)(C)||_2^2, with unconditional Phi*(V_u)<=n/u.

For every finite ordered position set, pairings within blocks of a noncrossing partition have noncrossing union. For every p and every covering list of k position-pairs, the number of p-labelings constant on those pairs is at most p^k.

For the prescribed tensor signal, ||kappa_m(C)||_2 <= 128^m p^(m/4) for all m>=1. All odd-order cumulants vanish. For even m>=4 the stronger squared bound ||kappa_m(C)||_2^2 <= 128^(2m) p^((m-2)/2) holds.

For every a>0, chi*(V_a)=L(a)-(1/2) integral_a^infinity [Phi*(V_u)-sum_i 1/(u+c_i)]du, with finite absolutely convergent deficit and chi*(V_(h+t))-chi*(V_h)=(1/2)integral_0^t Phi*(V_(h+s))ds. For a>2*128^2*sqrt(p), the deficit is at most 128^6*p^(3/2)/(3*a^3), and also at most 128^8*p/(6*a^4). These statements do not certify the microstates entropy separation.
The same selected sequence of matrix ensembles obeys the finite-time entropy-production transfer asserted in section 5. This branch is unexamined by the analytic mission.
The terminal ensembles retain the block event and the comparison GUE law has the asserted exponential rarity, as in section 6. This branch is unexamined by the analytic mission.
The noised tensor signal has a faithful bounded realization and finite original cutoff-limsup microstates entropy as asserted in section 4. This branch is not certified by the analytic mission.

claims.natural_statement: For every finite ordered position set, pairings within blocks of a noncrossing partition have noncrossing union. For every p and every covering list of k position-pairs, the number of p-labelings constant on those pairs is at most p^k.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Tactic

namespace AnalyticFisher

def NoncrossingPartition {m : ℕ} (R : Fin m → Fin m → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b c d, a < b → b < c → c < d → R a c → R b d → R a b

def NoCrossing {m : ℕ} (Q : Fin m → Fin m → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ a b c d, a < b → b < c → c < d → Q a c → Q b d → False

theorem noncrossing_union {m : ℕ} {R Q : Fin m → Fin m → Prop}
    (hR : NoncrossingPartition R)
    (refines : ∀ a b, Q a b → R a b)
    (within : ∀ a b c d, a < b → b < c → c < d →
      R a b → Q a c → Q b d → False) :
    NoCrossing Q := by
  intro a b c d hab hbc hcd hac hbd
  exact within a b c d hab hbc hcd
    (hR a b c d hab hbc hcd (refines a c hac) (refines b d hbd)) hac hbd

def PairConstant {m k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → Fin m) (f : Fin m → Fin p) : Prop :=
  ∀ j, f (a j) = f (b j)

theorem pairing_label_bound {m k p : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → Fin m)
    (covers : ∀ i, ∃ j, i = a j ∨ i = b j) :
    Fintype.card {f : Fin m → Fin p // PairConstant a b f} ≤ p ^ k := by
  classical
  let encode : {f : Fin m → Fin p // PairConstant a b f} → (Fin k → Fin p) :=
    fun f j => f.val (a j)
  have injective : Function.Injective encode := by
    intro f g h
    apply Subtype.ext
    funext i
    obtain ⟨j, hj | hj⟩ := covers i
    · subst i
      exact congrFun h j
    · subst i
      exact (f.property j).symm.trans ((congrFun h j).trans (g.property j))
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective encode injective

theorem family_pairing_label_bound {m k p t : ℕ}
    (a b : Fin t → Fin k → Fin m)
    (covers : ∀ s i, ∃ j, i = a s j ∨ i = b s j) :
    Fintype.card {f : Fin m → Fin p // ∃ s, PairConstant (a s) (b s) f} ≤
      t * p ^ k := by
  classical
  let decode :
      (Σ s : Fin t, {f : Fin m → Fin p // PairConstant (a s) (b s) f}) →
      {f : Fin m → Fin p // ∃ s, PairConstant (a s) (b s) f} :=
    fun sf => ⟨sf.2.val, ⟨sf.1, sf.2.property⟩⟩
  have surjective : Function.Surjective decode := by
    intro f
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := f.property
    exact ⟨⟨s, ⟨f.val, hs⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  calc
    Fintype.card {f : Fin m → Fin p // ∃ s, PairConstant (a s) (b s) f} ≤
        Fintype.card (Σ s : Fin t,
          {f : Fin m → Fin p // PairConstant (a s) (b s) f}) :=
      Fintype.card_le_of_surjective decode surjective
    _ = ∑ s : Fin t,
        Fintype.card {f : Fin m → Fin p // PairConstant (a s) (b s) f} := by
      simp only [Fintype.card_sigma]
    _ ≤ ∑ _s : Fin t, p ^ k := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro s _
      exact pairing_label_bound (a s) (b s) (covers s)
    _ = t * p ^ k := by simp

end AnalyticFisher
